comment:
Overall impression: There is a need for a multi-vendor and multi-country device interoperability infrastructure that is free of patient identifiable information in remote care. 

This is completely missing from this document and perpetuates vertically integrated silos for primary IoT data collection.

This is a major technical reason why Europe is lagging behind the USA in terms of remote patient monitoring adoption. 

Such a layer needs to uncouple two highly fragmented and regulated ecosystems: home medtech and health IT.
